controls.name: Prompt injection defense
controls.description: Detect and neutralize prompt injection via input validation, output filtering, separation of instructions from data, and least-privilege tool execution.
controls: NIST AI RMF: Govern/MAP - risk identification
controls.verification: Red-team prompt injection tests; adversarial input corpus; tool call allowlisting.
controls.implementation_guidance: Use dual LLM or classifier-based detection, delimiters, instruction/data separation, and tool permission boundaries.

controls.name: AI data governance and lineage
controls.description: Inventory training, validation, and test data; enforce provenance, licensing, and PII handling; protect against data poisoning and sensitive data leakage.
controls: EU AI Act high-risk data governance obligations
controls.verification: Data lineage audit; poison-attack simulations; data classification review.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain data catalogs, implement data classification, and use detection pipelines for anomalous training data.

controls.name: Least-privilege tool and delegated action control
controls.description: Limit agent access to tools, APIs, and data using least privilege, allowlists, human-in-the-loop checks for high-impact actions, and sandboxing.
controls: OWASP Agentic AI tool poisoning mitigations
controls.verification: Test tool permission matrix; simulate delegated abuse; code review of tool integration.
controls.implementation_guidance: Apply human approval gates to irreversible/high-privilege actions and enforce resource quotas.

controls.name: AI-specific threat modeling
controls.description: Apply AI threat models (MITRE ATLAS, ENISA) to identify, score, and track AI-specific threats systemically.
controls.verification: Threat model review; coverage check against ATLAS techniques.
controls.implementation_guidance: Maintain per-system threat models and map findings to controls and backlog.

controls.name: AI security monitoring and incident response
controls.description: Monitor model inputs/outputs, drift, anomalies, and adversarial events; maintain an AI-specific incident response plan.
controls.verification: Drift and anomaly detection tests; tabletop incident exercises.
controls.implementation_guidance: Log prompt/response, detect poisoning and extraction attempts, and define an AI incident taxonomy.

controls.name: AI supplier and model procurement assessment
controls.description: Assess AI suppliers and foundation models for security, transparency, compliance, and drift risk before procurement.
controls.verification: Supplier questionnaire; model transparency review; security assessment.
controls.implementation_guidance: Include AI-specific criteria in procurement and enforce contractual assurance obligations.

controls.name: AI control audit and evidence collection
controls.description: Produce auditable evidence of AI risk management, controls operation, and compliance to support internal and third-party assurance.
controls.verification: Control effectiveness evaluation; evidence traceability review.
controls.implementation_guidance: Map controls to evidence, maintain change records, and support conformity assessments.
